title: Cleanly-DINO: Efficiently Learning Visual Task Spaces for Robotics
abstract: arXiv:2611.20137v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning manipulation tasks from few demonstrations requires abstractions that capture the changes relevant to task completion, such as object poses in rigid-body manipulation. However, tasks such as cleaning are defined by changes in visual state rather than object pose, making the choice of task representation less clear. In this work, we propose Cleanly-DINO to learn visual task spaces from few demonstrations. Given a mask of a task-relevant region and frozen ViT features, Cleanly-DINO fits a projection to isolate a task space and fit a progression metric to it. We train the model on diverse cleaning examples and evaluate its ability to localize incomplete task regions and transfer across visual domains. We also study its utility for robot learning by using it as an observation encoder and reward signal in a reinforcement learning setting. Finally, we deploy our fitted model within a real-world robotic wiping pipeline to evaluate it

translated_title: Cleanly-DINO：为机器人技术高效学习视觉任务空间
translated_abstract: 从少量演示中学习操作任务需要能够捕捉与任务完成相关变化的抽象表示，例如刚体操作中的物体位姿。然而，诸如清洁之类的任务是由视觉状态的变化而非物体位姿来定义的，这使得任务表示的选择变得不那么明确。在本工作中，我们提出Cleanly-DINO，用于从少量演示中学习视觉任务空间。给定任务相关区域的掩码和冻结的ViT特征，Cleanly-DINO拟合一个投影来隔离出任务空间，并为其拟合一个进度度量。我们在多样化的清洁示例上训练该模型，并评估其定位未完成任务区域以及跨视觉域迁移的能力。我们还研究了它在机器人学习中的实用性，将其用作强化学习设置中的观测编码器和奖励信号。最后，我们将拟合好的模型部署到真实世界的机器人擦拭流程中进行评估。
tldr: 提出Cleanly-DINO方法，可从少量演示中高效学习视觉任务空间，能够定位未完成任务区域并跨视觉域迁移，还可作为强化学习的观测编码器和奖励信号，已成功部署于真实机器人擦拭任务中。
en_tdlr: Cleanly-DINO efficiently learns visual task spaces from few demonstrations, enabling localization of incomplete task regions, cross-domain transfer, and serving as observation encoder and reward signal for robot learning, with successful deployment in a real-world robotic wiping pipeline.
